welcome.intro: Your account is free, and Sensei Top works the same without it. It can do three things, each only if you say yes. Nothing is chosen for you, and you can change each answer later under Account in Settings.
welcome.stored: Your account itself (the email address, name and picture Google or Discord shared, and your answers here) is kept at Supabase, in São Paulo, Brazil.
welcome.kept: Your earlier answers are shown below and keep applying until you press Continue. You can change any of them here, or later under Account in Settings.

age.label: I'm 13 or older. If I'm under 18, a parent or guardian has said I can have an account and, if I choose to, send my games.
age.small: We store that you confirmed this, and when.

sync.title: Back up my match history
sync.what: A summary of each match is uploaded: when it was played, the format, your deck, the result and the opponent's cards you saw. It survives a reinstall and reaches your other PCs.
sync.where: It's kept at Supabase, in São Paulo, Brazil, until you delete it or your account. Your Arena and MTGO logs, names and chat are never uploaded.

errors.title: Send error reports
errors.what: When something goes wrong, the app sends a report to Sentry, in the United States. It holds the error, where in the code it happened, the app version and your system.
errors.linked: It's linked to your account by an internal ID, never by your email. Names, keys and file paths are removed before it's sent, and it's kept for 30 days.
errors.either: Either way, Report a problem sends one report each time you press it.

transfer.title: Sending error reports to the United States
transfer.law: Sentry stores error reports in the United States, so they leave Brazil. The United States has no data-protection law like Brazil's LGPD. Authorities there may be able to reach the reports under US law, and your rights may be harder to enforce there.
transfer.ip: Sentry doesn't store your IP address, but works out an approximate location from it first.
transfer.agree: I agree that my error reports are sent to Sentry, in the United States.
transfer.withdraw: If you don't agree, nothing is sent automatically. You can withdraw this at any time by turning error reports off.

coach.title: Keep my coach history
coach.kept: The rules coach comes in a later version. With this on, your questions and its answers are saved at Supabase, in Brazil, so you can reread them. They stay until you delete them or your account.
coach.off: With it off, neither is kept. Only when you asked, which model answered and what it cost is kept, for 90 days.

policy.lead: What is stored, where and for how long:

contribute.title: Help build the stats
contribute.storedNo: You said no to this on {{date}}. You can keep that answer or change it here.
contribute.apart: This isn't one of your account's choices. It works the same with or without an account, and your answer stays on this PC.
contribute.what: Saying yes sends your games to a private pool that Sensei Top's own stats are built from. That means the games already in your history and the ones you play from now on. Before a game leaves this PC, everything that names you or your opponent is removed, and it's sent without your sign-in.
contribute.pool: The pool is kept in Brazil, with no link to any account.
contribute.final: Nothing in a sent game says who sent it. Once it's sent, it can't be shown to you, copied or deleted, not even by deleting your account.
contribute.off: You can turn it off at any time in Settings, and nothing more is sent after that.

hint.answers: Confirm your age and answer each question to continue.
hint.transfer: To send error reports, agree to sending them to the United States, or choose Don't send.

welcome.declineNote: Deletes the account this sign-in just made, with what Google or Discord shared, and signs you out. Sensei Top works the same without one.

error.failed: Your answers were not saved, and nothing was changed. Try again.
error.declineFailed: The account was not deleted, and nothing was changed. Try again.
error.signOutFailed: You were not signed out. Try again.
